description.description: A snowy roadside scene featuring a red Ferrari. In the first frame, a woman in a red dress is kneeling on the snow-covered ground near the rear passenger wheel, attempting to change a flat tire with a jack and a spare tire nearby. A truck is visible in the background. In the second frame, the woman is seen lying on her side in the snow, still positioned next to the car's wheel, while a snowplow approaches in the distance on the same road.
